Two badgers, dressed neatly, were about to fight over a tiny matter.
Bear asked them, "Isn't there any other way to solve this?"
"No way," the badgers said angrily, "We must fight!"
Bear sighed helplessly, "Then let's fight."
Bear looked at the two badgers and reached out, saying, "Please take out all the money from your pockets."
"Why?" the two badgers asked in surprise.

"I can use this money to buy medicine. You'll definitely end up with your heads bleeding."

The two badgers looked at each other, reached into their pockets, pulled out the money, and said fiercely, "Take it, I don't care!"

The little bear took the money and said, "Give me your hats too."
"Why?" the two badgers asked in surprise.
"You'll knock your hats into the river."
"Take them!" the two badgers said angrily.

The little bear took the hat and said, "Take off your shirts too, you'll tear them."

The two badgers sniffed and took off their shirts.
Bear continued: 
"Take off your pants too, it's a pity to tear them."
The two badgers reluctantly took off their pants.
These are two badgers wearing shorts. They looked at each other's ridiculous appearance and felt a bit amused and embarrassed. They seemed to be preparing to fight their reflections in the mirror.
The cold wind made them shiver a little.
summary_zh: 两只獾在小熊的劝说下脱掉了上衣和裤子，准备打架，但因彼此滑稽的样子而哭笑不得，冷风也让他们发抖。

两只獾不想打架了，他们先要回了裤子。
小熊说：“你们没打架，裤子总算没扯坏。”
他们接着又要回了上衣。
小熊说：“要是打了架，这上衣肯定不会这样漂亮了。”
他们又要回了帽子。
小熊说：“戴这样好看的帽子的人，是不该打架的。”
他们又要回了各自的钱。
小熊说：“握手吧，由于你们没打架，就没有弄得丢盔弃甲、头破血流，而且还有零花钱，你们谢谢自己，也谢谢对方吧！”
page_text_en:
The two badgers didn't want to fight anymore, so they first got back their pants.
Bear said: "You didn't fight, so the pants are still intact."
Then they got back their shirts.
Bear said: "If you had fought, this shirt certainly wouldn't be so nice anymore."
Then they got back their hats.
Bear said: "People who wear such nice hats shouldn't fight."
Then they got back their own money.
Bear said: "Shake hands! Since you didn't fight, you didn't end up in tatters or with bloody heads, and you still have pocket money. Thank yourselves, and thank each other too!"
summary_zh: 两只獾在小熊的劝说下，陆续要回了裤子、上衣、帽子和钱，最终放弃打架，小熊建议他们握手并互相感谢。

The two badgers laughed.
They firmly shook hands with each other, and then they also warmly shook hands with the little bear.
summary_zh: 两只獾在小熊的劝说下停止了打架，彼此和小熊都亲切地握了手，化解了矛盾。
